university.name: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology
university.summary: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology is a private autonomous engineering college in Sathyamangalam, Tamil Nadu. Its taught portfolio covers engineering and technology at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, alongside an MBA. The campus provides laboratories, a learning centre, residential accommodation and medical services, with Anna University affiliation.
university.campusLifestyle: The campus includes academic buildings, a learning centre, laboratories, Wi-Fi, a cafeteria and a cooperative store. Laundry, ATMs and reverse-osmosis water facilities support day-to-day campus living.
university.cityProfile: The teaching campus is on the Sathy–Bhavani State Highway at Alathukombai, Sathyamangalam, in Erode district, Tamil Nadu 638401. Sathyamangalam is the canonical town; Erode is the district rather than a substitute campus city. TNEA counselling identifies the college with code 2702.
university.practicalExposure: Undergraduate Regulations 2026 include laboratory work, projects, employability-enhancement activities and industry-oriented courses. The MBA curriculum includes a four-week summer internship and a final-semester project. The ME curriculum includes dissertation phases in the third and fourth semesters. These academic components do not guarantee an internship placement or employment.
university.hostelOverview: Separate men’s and women’s hostels provide single, double and four-person room options. Hostel dining halls, kitchens and storage facilities are available. Room allocation and current hostel and mess charges require a separate accommodation budget.
university.dietarySupport: Hostel dining halls and a campus cafeteria provide meal facilities. The verified information does not specify allergy provision or every dietary option; these requirements should be discussed before accepting accommodation.
university.safetyOverview: The campus medical centre has resident medical officers, nursing staff and a round-the-clock emergency ambulance service for access to hospitals in Sathyamangalam, Coimbatore or Erode.
university.studentSupport: Undergraduate students are assigned a faculty mentor for course registration, academic progression and career objectives. Students Traffic can help compare the admission route, branch and full-cost plan.

faq.question: Is Bannari Amman Institute of Technology a university?
faq.answer: It is an autonomous engineering college affiliated to Anna University. Its UGC-DTBU webpage contains documents submitted for a deemed-to-be-university application; that is not proof that deemed status has been awarded.

faq.question: Where is Bannari Amman Institute of Technology?
faq.answer: The campus is at Alathukombai on the Sathy–Bhavani State Highway, Sathyamangalam 638401, in Erode district of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: How long are the regular undergraduate degrees?
faq.answer: The 2026 regulations specify four academic years across eight semesters for regular B.E./B.Tech. entry. Lateral entry has a separate three-year structure and eligibility conditions.

faq.question: What is the undergraduate teaching language?
faq.answer: The 2026 regulations use English for instruction, examinations and other academic activities, except courses specifically approved in Tamil. This does not establish the teaching language of every postgraduate programme.

faq.question: What is the TNEA counselling code?
faq.answer: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology appears in Anna University’s affiliated-college directory with TNEA code 2702 and examination code 7376.

faq.question: What documents are needed after government-quota allotment?
faq.answer: The college lists the provisional allotment order, school mark statements, transfer/conduct certificate, photograph and applicable category and first-graduate records. Medical fitness and an Aadhaar copy appear in its domestic joining checklist.

faq.question: Are campus hostels available?
faq.answer: Separate men’s and women’s hostels offer different room occupancies and dining facilities. Hostel charges and room allocation are separate decisions from an academic offer.

faq.question: Does the MBA include practical work?
faq.answer: The MBA regulations specify a four-week summer internship between the second and third semesters and project work in the fourth semester. Participation does not guarantee an employer placement.

faq.question: Are fees the same for every applicant?
faq.answer: A current full-cost plan should distinguish admission category, tuition, compulsory charges and accommodation. No annual tuition amount is stated here because the fee evidence does not establish one reliable category-specific annual rate.

faq.question: Are honours and minor pathways separate admissions?
faq.answer: The 2026 undergraduate rules provide honours and minor study within the curriculum. They are not separate first-entry programme offers.
